title: Microsoft Forms: Copilot in Forms for US Government clouds
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and accurately reports the published Copilot licence requirement and government-cloud prerequisites. It acknowledges Microsoft's inconsistent drafting entitlement descriptions and keeps the government-cloud default, separate availability switch and feature-level licensing split open.
